config.script:
data = self.view.custom.rawHistoryData
if not data:
	return
headers = list(data[0].keys()) if data else []
rows = []
for row in data:
	rows.append([str(row.get(h,'')) for h in headers])
csvText = ','.join(headers) + '\n'
for row in rows:
	csvText += ','.join(row) + '\n'
system.perspective.download('history_export.csv', csvText.encode('utf-8'), 'text/csv')
